{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq
sample_seq_dist = df['sample_seq'].value_counts().sort_index()

# Check how many patients have both sample_seq 1 and 2
patients_with_both = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].apply(lambda x: set(x) == {1, 2}).sum()

# Inspect the data for a few patients with both samples
example_patients = df[df['patient_id'].isin(df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].apply(lambda x: set(x) == {1, 2}).index)]

# Show the first few such patients
example_patients.head(10)

# Summary
print(f'sample_seq distribution: {sample_seq_dist}')
print(f'Patients with both sample_seq 1 and 2: {patients_with_both}')"}
